title: Robert Walmsley University Professor, Emeritus
bio: Frank I. Michelman is Robert Walmsley University Professor, Emeritus, Harvard University, where he has taught since 1963. He is the author of Brennan and Democracy (1999), Legitimation by Constitution, (2021, with Alessandro Ferrara), and Constitutional Essentials: On the Constitutional Theory of Political Liberalism (2022) and has published widely in the fields of constitutional law and theory, […]
